ai.overview: Arizona puts the College Basketball Belt on the line when they host New Orleans on December 1, 2026. The Wildcats have defended the belt once in their current reign and look to extend their streak against a Privateers squad that has never held the championship. This marks the first time these programs will meet with the belt at stake.
key_matchups: Arizona riding a 5-game winning streak including wins over UConn and Auburn
New Orleans seeking their first-ever belt after three all-time losses to Arizona
Wildcats' high-scoring offense averaging over 90 points in recent games
ai.betting_angles: Arizona enters on a 5-game winning streak with commanding victories, including a 96–83 win over Colorado State and an 80–69 road win at Auburn. New Orleans has struggled recently with losses of 41–86 at Texas Tech and 57–100 at LSU before their most recent 75–70 win at Texas Southern. Our Elo model makes Arizona a clear favorite, and the Wildcats hold a 3-0 all-time edge in this series.
ai.prediction_writeup: Arizona has been dominant with five straight wins and owns a perfect 3-0 record against New Orleans all-time. The Wildcats have been scoring efficiently, posting 96 against Colorado State and 104 against Cal Poly in their last five games. New Orleans has struggled on the road this season with heavy defeats at Texas Tech and LSU. With the belt on the line at home and momentum firmly on their side, Arizona should retain the championship comfortably.
